description: Database of Individual Seismogenic Sources (DISS), versione 3.3.0: Una raccolta di potenziali fonti per terremoti più grandi di M 5.5 in Italia e nelle aree circostanti. Database of Individual Seismogenic Sources (DISS), versione 3.3.0: Una raccolta di potenziali fonti per terremoti più grandi di M 5.5 in Italia e nelle aree circostanti is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by diss.ingv.it. DISS is a georeferenced repository of tectonic, fault, and paleoseismological information. The core objects of DISS are: - the individual seismogenic source, a simplified and three-dimensional representation of a fault plane. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Database of Individual Seismogenic Sources (DISS), version 3.3.0: A compilation of potential sources for earthquakes lar" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include magnitude, Italy, tsunami hazard, seismic hazard, earthquakes, active fault. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
